Gaining, losing, or consuming Armor Charge restores 5? HP and grants 'Repurposed Charge'. The number of Armor Charges changed simultaneously plus 1 determines the number of stacks granted. Maximum of 7 stacks, reached by losing or spending 6 Armor Charges at once through Kickstart or Finisher mods.

Repurposed Charge grants <pve 0%|13.1%|21%|29.8%|31%|33%|35% /> <pvp [0%|?%|?%|?%|?%|?%|?%] /> Damage Resistance at 1|2|3|4|5|6|7 stacks.

Each activation grants or extends the duration by 3 seconds per Repurposed Charge stack granted by that activation. Extensions maintain the highest stack count and cannot extend the remaining duration beyond 30 seconds.

Picking up an Orb of Power grants 2 stacks for 6 seconds. Special Finisher grants 4 stacks for 12 seconds; picking up an Orb of Power afterwards adds 6 seconds while maintaining 4 stacks.

source.text:
4 Piece | Repurposed Charge

Gaining, losing, or consuming Armor Charges restores 5? HP and grants stacks of Repurposed Charge.

Repurposed Charge stacks are based on the amount of simultaneously(!) gained/lost/consumed Armor charges + 1.
Maxes out at x7 with 6 Armor Charges simultaneously lost/spent through Kickstart or Finisher Mods.

Initial Buff duration as well as Buff Extensions are equal to (3 seconds X Repurposed Charge Stacks gained/lost/consumed)
 Buff can be extended to a maximum of 30 seconds, maintaining the highest stack.
Examples: Orb Pickups grant x2 (13% DR) for +6 seconds.
 Special Finisher will grant x4 (29.5% DR) for +12 seconds. Picking up an Orb afterwards will maintain x4 stacks and add +6 seconds.

Repurposed Charge:
Grant Damage Resist per Repurposed Charge stack, up to 35% [?%] DR at 7 stacks.
x1 = 0% [0%] | x2 = 13.1% [?%] | x3 = 21% [?%] | x4 = 29.8% [?%] | x5 = 31% [?%] | x6 = 33% [?%] | x7 = 35% [?%]
